verdict.rationale: Reclaim's docs say it automatically blocks flexible time for Tasks before their due dates, working around existing meetings and splitting long projects into chunks. They also say it automatically reschedules events when conflicts arise or a meeting overbooks a lower-priority smart event, using P1–P4 priorities, and that it works on real Google/Outlook calendars with task sync from Todoist, Asana, Jira and others. Community users say they drag calendar boxes around less, but one early hands-on report saw no reaction when a conflicting invite was added. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that task-specific automatic re-planning works reliably (vs. the one early failure report).
